source_line: on every page holding a chart or a table: true or false, read off the page; null elsewhere

exhibits.what: a picture of the report's own pages and a table of side-case downloads, fanned like a stack of documents
exhibits.message: the outlook is a suite of publications
exhibits.how_drawn: a pasted image, tilted page thumbnails beside a text column
exhibits.marks: nothing marked; the text column carries the point

exhibits.what: two side-by-side line charts of historical data against past projection vintages
exhibits.message: past projections tracked reality closely for total consumption and less so for electricity sales
exhibits.how_drawn: black historical line, grey fans of past vintages, the latest vintages in sky blue named at the right; light gridlines, comma thousands
exhibits.marks: series labels at line ends in coloured text explain each highlighted vintage; an inline label names the history line

exhibits.what: a two-column definition table of scenario cases: navy row headers on the left, light blue banded description cells on the right
exhibits.message: each case changes one assumption against the baseline
exhibits.how_drawn: white text on navy for the case name, black text on alternating pale blues for the definition, bold Low:/High: lead words; thin white rules between cells
exhibits.marks: bold lead words mark the low and high variants; nothing ringed

exhibits.what: a second two-column definition table of policy cases in the same navy and pale blue style
exhibits.message: the policy cases each toggle a regulation
exhibits.how_drawn: navy left column with white names, pale blue right column with black descriptions, white rules
exhibits.marks: nothing marked; an italic caveat line sits under the table

exhibits.what: a stacked horizontal bar chart of consumption by fuel per case, beside a dot plot of fuel shares by year across cases
exhibits.message: gas and oil stay the largest fuels in every case
exhibits.how_drawn: bars ordered with the 2025 row first, fuels stacked navy, sky blue, maroon, pink, greens and grey; a coloured word legend above the bars; dot plot rows with a pale grey bar for the 2025 value and translucent dots in fuel colours
exhibits.marks: an explanatory callout with a curved arrow says what each dot represents; the 2025 bar is labelled in grey text

exhibits.what: a single wide line chart of four sectors with shaded uncertainty ranges across cases
exhibits.message: industrial use grows most while the rest stay flat
exhibits.how_drawn: four sector lines in green, gold, orange and navy, each with a translucent band of its own hue after 2025; direct labels at the right end in bold matching colour; light gridlines
exhibits.marks: the 2025 dashed rule with 'projections' marks the start of the outlook; series named at the line ends

exhibits.what: a stacked horizontal bar chart of transport consumption by mode per case beside a line chart of gasoline use
exhibits.message: regulation cases cut gasoline use while the light-duty share dominates
exhibits.how_drawn: bars with 2025 first then cases in descending total, mode colours explained by a stacked word legend in matching colours at the right of the bars; line chart with grey other cases, black dashed baseline, pink named cases
exhibits.marks: the 2025 rule and 'projections'; coloured direct labels say which line is which

exhibits.what: line chart of battery electric vehicle share in light-duty stock across cases
exhibits.message: electric shares rise in every case
exhibits.how_drawn: thin grey lines for the side cases, the baseline as a black dashed line, named cases in colour; a vertical dashed grey rule at 2025 headed '2025' in bold grey with 'projections' to its right; light grey horizontal gridlines, comma thousands on the value axis, years on the category axis; no legend, series named directly at the right end in bold coloured text; percent axis
exhibits.marks: the 2025 rule and coloured names at line ends

exhibits.what: line chart of zero-emission truck stock share across cases
exhibits.message: trucks electrify more slowly and only with policy

exhibits.what: a fan line chart of data center electricity with a regional map inset in the third panel
